peers.name: reviewer
peers.purpose: Review and revise the implementation until both agree it is ready.

turns.final: On a 5xx response, `charge()` throws an error containing the status code instead of returning the charge ID.

calls.result: {"summary":"On a 5xx response, charge() throws an Error with message `payments: <status>` instead of returning the charge ID."}

commands:
bin/wf reply reviewer <<'WF_MSG'
charge() does not retry on a 503; it throws an Error with message `payments: 503`. The HTTP client is rebuilt on every charge() call, so it is not reused between calls.
WF_MSG
